note: Shared by __tests__/mcp-install-op-native-parity.test.ts (drives the real RN ladder) and McpInstallOpDecisionTest (JVM). handoff and not_attended are both the point where RN shows its tap dialog: native hands the request to RN only while RN is live and the request is fresh, else answers notAttended. answer = RN's exact result and its single audit line code. Dummy values only. stage_install (same native path since the foreground-for-approval change): RN's refuse() carries no code except for digest_changed / revoked, and its path / digest checks run before anything else (no epoch check first). The approval deadline is 5 min from receipt (owner decision 2026-11-29). The foreground-for-approval step and the lock-screen approval are native only: these cases model both as unavailable (phone locked, no full-screen intent), so RN paused is not_attended.

notAttended.message: Shelly is not in the foreground on the phone, and this update needs an approval tap there; nobody can approve it now (open Shelly and try again)
